title: Segmentation-Guided Direct Capacity Estimation of Rooftop Photovoltaics from Aerial Imagery
abstract: arXiv:2611.22076v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Distribution planners need installation-level inventories of rooftop photovoltaic (PV) capacity, but interconnection records may be incomplete or spatially aggregated. Conventional image-based estimators segment PV arrays, convert the mask to physical area, and multiply by an estimated power density, coupling capacity prediction to mask-derived area. We propose Direct Head, a segmentation-guided architecture that retains U-Net segmentation and soft-mask pooling while directly regressing nonnegative capacity from PV-region features and area descriptors. We evaluate three independent runs on 7,590 French rooftop installations under the original split and a department-based holdout. Relative to a parameter-matched area-density neural model, Direct Head reduces mean absolute error by 8.7% and 12.5%, and symmetric mean absolute percentage error by 14.0% and 20.7%, respectively. translated_title: 基于航空影像的分割引导屋顶光伏容量直接估计
translated_abstract: 配电规划人员需要安装级别的屋顶光伏（PV）容量清单，但并网记录可能不完整或在空间上被聚合。传统的基于图像的估计器先对光伏阵列进行分割，将掩膜转换为物理面积，再乘以估计的功率密度，从而使容量预测与掩膜导出的面积相互耦合。我们提出了Direct Head，这是一种分割引导的架构，在保留U-Net分割和软掩膜池化的同时，直接从光伏区域特征和面积描述符回归出非负容量。我们在7,590个法国屋顶光伏装置上，分别在原始数据划分和基于省的留出集两种设置下进行了三次独立运行评估。与参数数量匹配的面积-密度神经网络模型相比，Direct Head将平均绝对误差分别降低了8.7%和12.5%，将对称平均绝对百分比误差分别降低了14.0%和20.7%。与常规估计器的比较以及受控架构……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Direct Head分割引导架构，在保留U-Net分割与软掩膜池化的同时直接从航空影像回归屋顶光伏容量，摆脱了传统“掩膜面积×功率密度”的间接估计方式，在7,590个法国屋顶装置上将误差最多降低20.7%。
en_tdlr: Proposes Direct Head, a segmentation-guided architecture that retains U-Net segmentation and soft-mask pooling while directly regressing rooftop PV capacity from aerial imagery instead of relying on mask-derived area times power density, reducing error by up to 20.7% sMAPE on 7,590 French rooftop installations.
